commits.message:
M0: CADCraft skeleton and vertical slice

Workspace (geom, dxf, color, doc, fonts, render, io, engine, ui-egui, mcp; apps cadcraft,
cadcraft-cli, cadcraft-web; xtask), AutoCAD-for-Mac style UI with code-drawn icons, command line
with prompts/keywords/AutoComplete, draw and modify commands, object snaps, polar/ortho,
selection, undo, layers and properties palettes, DXF read/write, SVG/PNG export, MCP server,
JSON control channel, CLI, wasm build, README, ROADMAP, AGENTS.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
